name: Jenkins
description: Jenkins in Kalem, with QuickPipeline inside: parameterized pipelines read from Jenkins, a tree of environments whose variables targets inherit, quick actions (Start, Stop, Restart…) run on one target or a whole group after a preview, and the builds followed to their result. Browse jobs and builds, read consoles and stages, and let the assistant find why a build failed. Imports QuickPipeline's config.json.
